summary.short: Mexican presidential decree of 20 January 2025 granting federal income-tax incentives under the Plan México strategy: immediate deduction of new fixed-asset investment and an additional deduction for training and innovation spending, for taxpayers meeting listed requirements, in force the day after DOF publication and running to 30 September 2030.
summary.long: Presidential decree of 20 January 2025 granting federal income-tax incentives under the Plan México strategy. Article Primero grants them to legal entities and individuals meeting listed requirements, including a positive tax-compliance opinion, an investment project, an SEP dual-education agreement where relevant, and a compliance certificate from an Evaluation Committee. It allows immediate deduction of new fixed-asset investments acquired until 30 September 2030, subject to a two-year minimum use period and exclusions; Article Segundo sets deduction percentages by asset type and activity for 2025-2026 and 2027-2030. Article Cuarto grants an additional deduction of 25% of the increase in training spending for active workers and of innovation spending linked to patent or initial-certification projects. Article Quinto creates the Evaluation Committee (chaired by SHCP) and caps total incentives at 30 billion pesos, of which 28.5 billion for investment and 1.5 billion for the additional deduction, with at least 1 billion for taxpayers with prior-year income up to 100 million pesos. Article Sexto excludes listed taxpayers; Article Séptimo requires repayment of tax, adjustments and surcharges on non-compliance; Article Octavo authorises SAT rules. Entry into force is the day after DOF publication; the decree repeals the 2023 export-sector incentive decree.

notes: The guidelines (lineamientos) of the Comité de Evaluación are not part of this text. Eligibility criteria, procedure and the constancia de cumplimiento depend on them (Art. Primero fracciones IV-V, Art. Quinto, Art. Sexto IX, Transitorio Cuarto). Art. Tercero refers to depreciation tables that are not reproduced in the text supplied, so the schedule of post-deduction adjustments cannot be checked here. The amounts in the Considerandos and Art. Quinto (30 mil millones total; 28 mil 500 and 1 mil 500 millones by component; at least 1 mil millones for taxpayers with income up to 100 millones) are consistent. The decree is dated 20 January 2025; the DOF publication date 21-01-2025 comes from the registry metadata, not from the text.

obligations.summary: Taxpayers (personas morales and personas físicas named in Art. Primero) must meet cumulative requirements to obtain the incentive: RFC registration with buzón tributario, positive tax compliance opinion, submission of the investment project and SEP dual-education agreement (and patent or initial certification project where applicable), a constancia de cumplimiento from the Comité de Evaluación, and compliance with its guidelines.
obligations.applies_from: Investments acquired from the date of entry into force of the decree until 30 September 2030 (Art. Primero, first paragraph of the incentive).
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to the taxpayers that elect the immediate deduction under Art. Primero.

obligations.summary: Taxpayers electing the immediate deduction must keep a specific register of the investments, with supporting documentation, type of asset, link to principal activity, process in which used, applied percentage, year of deduction and date of disposal, loss or obsolescence.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers that opt for the immediate deduction of new fixed assets under Art. Primero.

evidence.provision: Art. Primero, cuarto párrafo del estímulo
evidence.quote: Los contribuyentes deben llevar un registro específico de las inversiones por las que optó por aplicar la deducción inmediata

obligations.summary: The immediate deduction applies only to investments kept in use for a minimum of two years after the year of deduction (exceptions under Art. 37 LISR), and only to new fixed assets acquired for exclusive use in the taxpayer's activities; listed assets (office furniture, internal-combustion automobiles, armour equipment, non-individually identifiable assets, aircraft other than agricultural spraying) are excluded.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to investments made under the immediate deduction in Art. Primero.

evidence.provision: Art. Primero, párrafos segundo y tercero del estímulo
evidence.quote: solo será aplicable respecto de aquellas inversiones que los contribuyentes mantengan en uso durante un periodo mínimo de dos años inmediatos siguientes

obligations.summary: Taxpayers applying the immediate deduction must compute the provisional-payment profit coefficient by adding the deduction to taxable profit or reducing the tax loss for the relevant year, must spread the deducted amount evenly over provisional payments from the month of investment, and must not recalculate the coefficient under Art. 14 fracción I LISR.
obligations.applies_from: Fiscal years 2025 to 2030 (deduction years) and provisional payments of 2026 to 2031.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers that apply the immediate deduction in fiscal years 2025 to 2030.

evidence.provision: Art. Primero, tercer y cuarto párrafos del estímulo
evidence.quote: deben calcular el coeficiente de utilidad de los pagos provisionales que se efectúen durante el ejercicio fiscal de 2026

obligations.summary: Taxpayers with two or more activities listed in Art. Segundo fracción II must apply the percentage for the activity that produced most of their income in the year of the deduction.
obligations.applies_from: Fiscal year in which the immediate deduction is applied.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers engaged in two or more activities listed in Art. Segundo, fracción II.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, fracción II, párrafo final
evidence.quote: se debe aplicar el porciento que le corresponda a la actividad en la que hubiera obtenido la mayor parte de sus ingresos

obligations.summary: Taxpayers that opt for the immediate deduction must follow the adjustment, disposal and deduction rules of Art. Tercero, including inflation-factor adjustment of the original investment and the annual deduction schedules for disposed or lost assets.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers that exercise the option in Art. Primero for the assets to which they applied it.

evidence.quote: Los contribuyentes que ejerzan la opción establecida en el artículo Primero de este decreto, por los bienes a los que la aplicaron, deben estar a lo siguiente
